title: Design System: Egyphoria — The Continental Timetable

display.purpose: The H1 only, one per page.

title.purpose: Board place names, week-strip stations, founders' names.

label.purpose: Table column headers (departures board, destinations table).

motion.name: board-settle
motion.value: translateY(12px)->0, opacity 0->1, 420ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), 40ms stagger per row via inline --i
motion.purpose: The one authored motion moment: departures-board rows settle top-to-bottom on first paint, like flaps dropping into a split-flap display. Disabled entirely under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The homepage's one reserved-yellow action: "Build my itinerary".
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; padding: 16px 28px; background: var(--yellow, #f2c10f); color: var(--ink, #15181d); border: 1px solid var(--yellow, #f2c10f); font-family: 'Archivo Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; transition: transform 0.2s, background 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #d1a70d; border-color: #d1a70d; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue, #0b2f6b); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Platform Button
components.description: The ordinary action color everywhere else on the site — signal blue, not the rationed yellow.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; padding: 16px 24px; background: var(--blue, #0b2f6b); color: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--blue, #0b2f6b); font-family: 'Archivo Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.2s; } .ds-btn:hover { background: #082352; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue, #0b2f6b); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Link
components.description: Underlined hairline link used in the week strip, share block and footer legalese.
components.css: .ds-text-link { display: inline-flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; color: var(--blue, #0b2f6b); font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #cfd6e3); padding: 6px 0; transition: border-color 0.15s; } .ds-text-link:hover { border-color: var(--blue, #0b2f6b); } .ds-text-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue, #0b2f6b); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Language Cell
components.description: One of six two-letter language cells in the header's timetable-style switcher; the current locale's cell is filled sun-yellow.
components.html:
• NL
  • EN
components.css: .ds-lang-cells { display: flex; gap: 4px; list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-lang-cell { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 34px; height: 28px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35); color: #fff; font-family: 'Archivo Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: .02em; } .ds-lang-cell:hover { border-color: #fff; } .ds-lang-cell-current { background: var(--yellow, #f2c10f); color: var(--ink, #15181d); border-color: var(--yellow, #f2c10f); }

components.name: Station Toggle Chip
components.description: The itinerary builder's destination/interest toggle — a checkbox visually hidden and stretched under a square hairline chip.
components.css: .ds-chip { cursor: pointer; position: relative; display: inline-block; } .ds-chip input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; margin: 0; } .ds-chip span { display: block; border: 1px solid var(--line, #cfd6e3); padding: 9px 14px; font-size: 13px; transition: background .15s, color .15s, border-color .15s; } .ds-chip input:checked + span { background: var(--blue, #0b2f6b); color: #fff; border-color: var(--blue, #0b2f6b); } .ds-chip input:focus-visible + span { outline: 3px solid var(--blue, #0b2f6b); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Departures Board Row
components.description: Signature component: one row of the homepage's real <table> departures board — a stretched whole-row link, a two-line place cell, tabular-figure days/price/months, and a hover/focus state that turns the row sun-yellow.

components.css: .ds-board { font-family: 'Archivo Narrow', sans-serif; border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; border-top: 2px solid var(--blue, #0b2f6b); } .ds-board thead th { text-align: left; padding: 12px 20px; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted, #55606c); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #cfd6e3); font-weight: 600; font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; } .ds-board tbody tr { position: relative; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #cfd6e3); } .ds-board tbody td { padding: 18px 20px; font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-board-row-link { color: inherit; } .ds-board-row-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; } .ds-board-row-place { display: block; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.15rem; } .ds-board-row-title { display: block; font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: .92rem; color: var(--muted, #55606c); margin-top: 2px; } .ds-board-arrow { color: var(--blue, #0b2f6b); text-align: right; font-weight: 700; } .ds-board tbody tr:hover, .ds-board tbody tr:focus-within { background: var(--yellow, #f2c10f); } .ds-board tbody tr:hover td, .ds-board tbody tr:focus-within td { color: var(--ink, #15181d); }

narrative.overview:
Egyphoria's homepage sells a private Egypt trip the way Europeans already trust travel: as an honest board of places, days, prices and connections, in the visual language of Cook's Continental Timetable and the classic European departures board. It refuses the category default — no full-bleed pyramid photo with a search box floating over it. Instead, signal blue fields own whole regions of the page (the header band, the board's top rule, the builder strip, the footer) the way a station's livery owns its concourse, white carries the boards themselves, and one sun-yellow is spent on exactly the things a traveller needs to notice fast: the primary action and the row they're looking at.

The system is dense with real information and light on decoration. Every number on the page — a day count, a price, a month range — is set in tabular figures so it lines up like a printed schedule. Real <table> markup carries the departures board and the destinations list because this is tabular data, not a design metaphor to fake with divs. The one authored flourish is restrained: board rows settle into place top-to-bottom on first paint, like flaps dropping into a split-flap display, then the page goes still. Station photography appears only in the gaps between boards, full-bleed, captioned, never behind text.
keyCharacteristics: Signal blue owns regions; it is not a decorative accent, it is a background material.
Sun-yellow is rationed to the primary action, the active board row, and the current-language cell — nowhere else.
Real <table>s for real tabular content; no div-grid impersonating a table.
Every figure (price, days, months) in tabular numerals.
Zero border-radius anywhere in the system; hairline rules do the separating work a shadow or a rounded card would otherwise do.
One authored motion moment (the board settle), switched off completely under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

rules.name: The One Yellow Rule
rules.body: Sun-yellow appears in exactly three places on the homepage — the primary action button, the hovered/focused departures-board row, and the current-language cell — and nowhere else. It never decorates a heading, a badge, or a photo caption.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every price, day count and month range in the departures board and destinations table sets font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums — figures line up column-to-column the way a printed timetable's do.

rules.name: The Greek Understudy Rule
rules.body: Archivo Narrow and Archivo ship no Greek subset on Google Fonts. Roboto Condensed and Roboto, loaded subsets: ['greek'] only, sit after the Archivo variables in the --serif/--sans stacks. Font-stack fallback resolves per glyph, not per element, so Latin text keeps rendering in Archivo and only the Greek characters Archivo can't draw fall through to the Roboto pair.

rules.name: The Flat Board Rule
rules.body: A named-color surface (blue band, white board, yellow row) is flat at rest and stays flat on hover — state changes color, never elevation.

rules.name: The Square Corner Rule
rules.body: Nothing rounds. A button, a chip, a table row, a photograph and a language cell are all right-angled; the only permitted "shape" event is a 1–2px hairline or a full-bleed photo edge.

dos: Do keep every route under /{lang}/ — there is no locale-free homepage path.
Do reserve sun-yellow for exactly three things: the primary CTA, the hovered/focused board row, and the current-language cell.
Do render tabular content (the departures board, the destinations list) as a real <table> with <caption>/<th scope>, not a div-grid pretending to be one.
Do set font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums on every price, day count, and month range.
Do layer Roboto Condensed/Roboto after Archivo Narrow/Archivo in the font stack for the Greek subset, so Latin glyphs stay in Archivo and only Greek falls through.
Do keep the board-settle motion as the only authored animation, gated behind prefers-reduced-motion.
Do render founders/reviews content only when content/founders.json / content/reviews.json actually has it — no image, no section, no schema when the data is empty or null.
donts: Don't add an eyebrow/kicker above the H1 or any H2 on this homepage — headings carry themselves. (Older, not-yet-migrated pages — /journal, /destinations, /about — still use .eyebrow; don't extend that pattern into the Continental Timetable world.)
Don't build icon-card scaffolds (icon + heading + short text in a tile) — tables and rows are the structure here, not cards.
Don't apply gradient text anywhere in this system.
Don't run a hero image or photograph behind the H1 or the board — station photography is full-bleed and appears only between boards, never behind text.
Don't round any corner — there is no border-radius in this system; buttons, chips, and table cells all stay square.
Don't add a drop shadow to a homepage surface — depth comes from color fields and hairline rules only, not box-shadow.
Don't invent a trip price, a founder photo, or a review quote/count — render the owner-supplied JSON/data exactly as given, or render nothing at all.
